Etobicoke basement: where does the rain go?

Brampton: $150 a week each for four years. What could a couple save toward a down payment?

Example only, simple arithmetic (no interest, no FHSA growth):
1) $150 x 52 weeks = $7,800 a year.
2) $7,800 x 4 years = $31,200 for one person.
3) A co-buyer saving the same amount: $31,200 + $31,200 = $62,400 together.
This is saving only; closing costs are extra and lenders may require more. Your numbers will differ.

caption:
Georgetown: title insurance. Waste of money?

Title insurance is a one-time cost that can protect against some title problems, but it has limits. 1) It can cover issues such as title fraud, liens and some survey or public-record errors. 2) It does not cover defects you already know about. 3) A lender's policy protects the lender; an owner's policy protects you. 4) Ask your lawyer which policy you are getting and what it covers. Coverage depends on the policy.

Buying in Georgetown? Comment INFO to get full details, or call 905-452-4298.
